body: Demo with Dana Whitfield and two dispatchers. They run 60 field techs across three branches and still build the schedule in a shared spreadsheet every morning. Biggest pain is reshuffling the day when an emergency call comes in. Dana liked the drag and drop board and the tech mobile app. Asked for a proposal for all 60 techs.

subject: Fieldnote proposal for Kettlebrook
body:
Hi Dana,

Thanks again for the time on Monday. As promised, the proposal is attached: 60 technician seats at $600 per seat per year, so $36,000 annually, including onboarding for your three dispatch leads.

Happy to walk Glen through it whenever useful.

Best,
Maya Lindgren
Account Executive, Fieldnote
(415) 555-0142
Quick check-in with Dana. She has shared the proposal with Glen (CFO). No pushback on price so far. She wants the dispatch leads in the sandbox next week before anything goes further.

subject: Sandbox week
body:
Hi Maya,

Hope your week has been good! I wanted to send a proper update since the team has been in the sandbox all week.

Honestly it went better than I expected. Carla and Mike, two of our dispatch leads, rebuilt Tuesday's whole schedule in about twenty minutes, which normally eats most of their morning. The techs who tried the mobile app liked that the job notes and photos are right there, and nobody asked me how to log in twice, which for this group is a small miracle. Mike did ask whether we can color code jobs by branch on the board. Is that something you can turn on, or is it on the roadmap?

A couple of smaller questions while I have you:
1. Can we import our existing customer list from a CSV, or does that need to go through your team?
2. Is there a way to see drive time between jobs on the board?

Also, thank you for the restaurant tip in Portland. We went on Saturday and the brisket was as good as you said.

Talk soon,
Dana

Dana Whitfield
Director of Operations, Kettlebrook Heating & Air

P.S. Before I forget: Glen told us on Thursday that all new software spend is on hold until our fiscal year starts in January, so we won't be able to sign anything before February 1. I'm still pushing for this internally, I just wanted you to hear it from me.

subject: Re: Sandbox week
body:
Hi Dana,

So glad the sandbox week went well, and thanks for the honest note. Answers: yes on CSV import, color by branch is a setting I can turn on today, and drive time is on the board under View.

I'll check back in with you later this month.

Maya Lindgren
Account Executive, Fieldnote
(415) 555-0142
